welcome.title: Welcome to Seen Smart System 👋
welcome.subtitle: Let's take a quick tour so you know everything the system can do for you.
welcome.subtitle_tenant: Let's take a quick tour of {{tenant}} so you know everything you can do here.
welcome.highlight1_desc: ZATCA-compliant simplified tax invoices in seconds
welcome.highlight2_desc: From measurements to cutting, sewing and delivery
welcome.highlight3_desc: Profit, stock and team performance in one live dashboard
welcome.skip_full: Skip, I'll explore on my own
welcome.restart_hint: You can replay this tour any time from the user menu or Settings.

sidebar.title: Main navigation 🧭
sidebar.desc: Your gateway to every part of the system: point of sale, orders, customers, inventory, suppliers, reports and settings. You only see the sections your role allows.

dashboard.title: Dashboard 📊
dashboard.desc: The first thing you check each morning: today's sales, orders in progress, outstanding balances and low-stock alerts — a quick pulse on your shop.

pos_intro.title: Point of sale (POS) 🖥️
pos_intro.desc: This is where you create invoices and record sales. Three main tabs: POS for direct selling, Returns for refunds, and Shifts for cash drawer management.

pos_shift.title: Shift & cash drawer 💰
pos_shift.desc: A shift is opened under the cashier's name before selling. Track the drawer balance live, log cash in and out, and close the shift with a cash count at day's end.

pos_subtabs.title: Sales log & tax invoices 🧾
pos_subtabs.desc: Every sale is saved here automatically. You'll find the daily sales log and simplified tax invoices with QR codes, ready to print or share.

orders_new.title: Create a new tailoring order ✂️
orders_new.desc: The starting point for any order: pick the customer, enter measurements, choose fabric, model and delivery date, then record the deposit.

orders_tabs.title: Active vs. completed orders 📋
orders_tabs.desc: Active orders are still in progress (cutting, sewing, ready for pickup). Completed ones have been delivered and paid. Switch with a single click.

orders_search.title: Search & barcode 🔍
orders_search.desc: Search by order number, customer name or phone — or scan the order tag barcode with your camera to jump straight to it.

customers_add.title: Add a new customer 👤
customers_add.desc: Record the customer once — name, phone and measurements — and they'll be filled in automatically on every future order.

customers_search.title: Customer records & statements 📇
customers_search.desc: Search your customer base, review order history and measurements, and print a financial statement for anyone with an outstanding balance.

inventory_tabs.title: Inventory & fabrics 📦
inventory_tabs.desc: Manage fabrics and supplies here: stock list with quantities and costs, transfers between branches and warehouses, and stock movement reports.

inventory_actions.title: Opening balances & transfers 🔄
inventory_actions.desc: Start by entering opening balances for what's physically in your shop, add new items, and move quantities between branches with a full audit trail.

suppliers.title: Suppliers & procurement 🚛
suppliers.desc: Register your suppliers, raise purchase orders for fabrics and supplies, and log returns. Supplier balances and due invoices are tracked automatically.

reports_tabs.title: Reports centre 📈
reports_tabs.desc: Detailed reporting: overview dashboard, financials, order and inventory reports, staff and customer performance, tailor commissions, and Z-reports for end of day.

reports_filters.title: Filters & export 🎛️
reports_filters.desc: Narrow any report by date range, staff member and payment status, then export to Excel or PDF to share with your accountant.

settings.title: Shop settings ⚙️
settings.desc: Customise everything here: shop details and logo, branches, staff and permissions, invoice layout and printer, VAT number, notifications and subscription.

preferences.title: Your preferences 🌓
preferences.desc: From your account menu you can switch language (عربي / English / اردو), toggle dark mode, change the layout, and lock the screen when you step away.

ai_assistant.title: SeenAI assistant 🤖
ai_assistant.desc: Your in-app assistant — soon it will help analyse your sales and answer questions about how your shop is doing. It's always one click away here.

finish.title: You're all set! 🎉
finish.subtitle: Tour complete. Here are the first suggested steps to get your shop ready and start working.
